meta.name: Homestay Murders
meta.description: A group of strangers get together at Ananya Homestay, surrounded by the mysterious silence of the mountains. When one of them is murdered, they confront each other's secrets and motives and uncover the truth before the killer strikes again

videos.title: Check in
videos.overview: A group of tourists arrive at Ananya Homestay, nestled in the quiet of the mountains. However, everything comes to a screeching halt when one of them is found dead.

videos.title: Blackout Date
videos.overview: Kinjal begins an investigation after getting suspicious of everyone's whereabouts at the time of the murder. As Animesh tries to figure out Damini's alibi, Mita reveals her last encounter with Kuhli, encircling a cryptic threatening note.

videos.title: Peak Night
videos.overview: Kinjal finds a whiff of revenge behind Manisha and Kuheli's murders. When Damini's erratic behaviour sparks everyone's suspicion, Animesh warns Kinjal about Damini's questionable past.

videos.title: The Banquet
videos.overview: The mysterious death of Piya, who was a close acquaintance of Kuheli and Manisha, spurs a new mystery. When everyone suspects someone close to Piya may have come in disguise to seek revenge, another death shakes everyone up.

videos.title: House Count
videos.overview: When Mita's body suddenly disappears, the killer slowly sheds his disguise. As the horrific truth behind Piya's death comes to light, another revelation leaves everyone stunned.

videos.title: Check out
videos.overview: As the killer's identity comes to light, everyone begins to piece together the last pieces of the puzzle. Unbeknownst to them, a new surprise awaits them.
